title: Cloudflare起動へ一本化：雨監視2ワークフローのGitHub scheduleを削除
purpose: 雨量判定・予測・全国候補抽出に関する変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
## 変更
- `.github/workflows/my-rain-watch-schedule.yml` の `schedule` を削除
- `.github/workflows/national-heavy-rain-schedule.yml` の `schedule` を削除
- 両方の `workflow_dispatch`、Production Secrets、既存ガード、実行内容は維持

## 理由
Cloudflare Workers Cronからの5分起動へ移行したため、GitHub scheduleの不要な発火・二重起動経路を除去する。関連 #274 #256 #259 #250。

## 検証・反映条件
- 両workflowの差分が `schedule` 削除のみであることを確認
- 最新HEADのCI成功を確認してからmainへのマージを判断
- Cloudflare Cron→GitHub workflow_dispatchの継続と実監視記録をマージ後に確認

ユーザー了承済み。雨判定・通知ロジックやSupabase/Vercelには変更なし。

name: MY Amefuru rain watch

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: my-rain-watch-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  watch:
    if: github.repository == 'miyazaki1016/emergencyalert' && vars.MY_RAIN_WATCH_ACTIONS_ENABLED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'schedule' || vars.RAIN_ACTIONS_TRIGGER_SOURCE != 'cloudflare')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Production
    timeout-minutes: 4
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Reject stale queued runs and re-runs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
          created=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --jq .created_at)
          age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(date -u -d "$created" +%s) ))
          if [ "$age" -ge 240 ]; then
            echo 'Watch invocation missed its run window'
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Invoke the existing watch-rain endpoint
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          WATCH_CRON_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WATCH_CRON_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/run-watch-rain.mjs

name: Nationwide heavy rain forecast

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: national-heavy-rain-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  scan:
    if: github.repository == 'miyazaki1016/emergencyalert' && vars.NATIONAL_HEAVY_RAIN_ACTIONS_ENABLED == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'schedule' || vars.RAIN_ACTIONS_TRIGGER_SOURCE != 'cloudflare')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Production
    timeout-minutes: 9
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npm install --no-save --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund tsx@4.20.6
      # These official-N03-derived assets were already shared in the public
      # verification artifacts. Never cache credentials or signed URLs here.
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        id: inputs
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/n03
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lrpm
          key: national-heavy-rain-n03-20260101-lrpm-v1-5fb0823f190e
      - name: Prepare verified N03 and LRPM inputs
        id: prepare
        if: steps.inputs.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: node --import tsx scripts/prepare-national-rain-inputs.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/n03" "$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm"
      - name: Scan and publish latest fresh forecast
        env:
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
          JMA_Z10_CONCURRENCY: '8'
        run: JMA_Z10_PIXEL_MASK_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/lrpm/20260101-v1" node --import tsx scripts/national-heavy-rain-scan.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/n03"
      - uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        if: always() && steps.inputs.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/n03
            ${{ runner.temp }}/lrpm
          key: ${{ steps.inputs.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
